name: Cursor Setup
description: Global Cursor setup for agents, starter skills, and Playwright MCP without project writes.

skills.note: Skills are one surface for every harness: the app installs them into the folders the enabled harnesses read (~/.claude/skills, ~/.agents/skills), and Cursor reads both.

notes: Apply via the Riggverk Cursor page.
Select Auto Review manually in Cursor Settings; Riggverk does not inspect undocumented Cursor state.
Legacy permissions and sandbox profiles are no longer managed by Riggverk.
